title: Skill slow motion (Riotous Fury) for the played pawn
intro: BEFORE YOU PRESS END: open ground, and the pawn you play must have Riotous Fury (or another skill with a slow-motion moment) equipped. Press End to start.

steps.text: GET READY (no timer): stand in the open. Press End to spawn unkillable goblins and take over your main pawn.
AS THE PAWN: use Riotous Fury on the goblins 3 or 4 times. Does the world slow down like it does for the Arisen? (The first use may still miss.)
Done: goblins gone, back to the Arisen. Tell Claude what you saw.
